vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Ford LH/RH and the L/R sides here = vehicle's own left/right (LH/L = UK nearside, N/S, passenger side; RH/R = offside, O/S, driver side). Numbers were read from web-search results (titles and extracts) of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked (shop.ford.co.uk returned a proxy 403). Ford UK shop numbers are 7-digit finis codes; eBay numbers are mostly engineering numbers (JX7B-... pre-facelift design, MX7B-... facelift-era), and bumper numbers such as JX7B-17757-A/-S are moulded base numbers seen on used parts, not the dealer order number. Pre-facelift (2018-2021/22) and facelift (2022-2025) front-end parts, headlamps and rear lamps differ. Several numbers come from aftermarket listings quoting the OE reference; these are flagged in notes. Coverage is partial (24 searches): no front/rear door, rear bumper cover, tailgate, condenser or intercooler numbers could be tied to a source, and wheels, TPMS and parking sensors were not searched. Check every number against the VIN before use.
